49.title: doesn't like 与 either
49.chat: 说「他喜欢」要加 s：He likes steak. 说「他不喜欢」用 doesn't + 动词原形：He doesn't like chicken.（doesn't 已经替你背了 s，后面的动词变回原形）。「我也不喜欢」在句尾用 either！
49.formula: He/She + likes… ／ doesn't like… ｜ 句尾 …, either.（也<不>……）

examples.en: My husband doesn't like chicken.
I don't like chicken either!
Do you want beef or lamb?

49.watch: too 用在肯定句尾（I like it too 我也喜欢），either 用在否定句尾（I don't like it either 我也不喜欢）！

51.title: What's the weather like?
51.chat: 问天气的专用句：What's the weather like?（天气怎么样？）——这里的 like 是「像……样子」，不是「喜欢」！季节、月份前面用 in：in spring、in March。雨和雪还能当动词：It rains. It snows.
51.formula: What's the weather like in + 季节/月份? → It's windy / warm / hot.

examples.en: What's the climate like in your country?
It's often windy in March.
It's always hot in June, July and August.

51.watch: climate 指一个地方长期的气候特点；weather 指天气情况，可以说今天、某一天，也可以说某个季节的天气，并不只限今天。

53.title: 方位与 favourite
53.chat: 说一个国家的方位要加 the：in the North（在北方）、in the East（在东方）。说「最喜欢的」用 favourite，它天生带着「最」字，前面不能再加 most！
53.formula: in the North / East / South / West ｜ favourite + 名词 = 最喜欢的……

examples.en: It's often cold in the North.
I like spring and summer best.
It's our favourite subject of conversation.
examples.cn: 这是我们最爱聊的话题。

53.watch: favourite = 最喜欢的：不说 most favourite，「最」已经包含在里面了！

55.title: 一般现在时与动词的 s
55.chat: 讲每天的习惯动作，用一般现在时。含实义动词的肯定句中，主语是 he/she/it 等第三人称单数时，动词通常加 s 或 es：goes、does、watches、stays。always（总是）、usually（通常）、often（经常）通常放在实义动词前、be 动词后。
55.formula: He/She + 实义动词s/es + 时间. ｜ always/usually/often 通常在实义动词前、be 动词后

examples.en: Mr. Sawyer goes to work early.
She always eats her lunch at noon.
They often drink tea together.

55.watch: 三单动词忘加 s 是小学生第一大扣分点：he like ❌ → he likes ✓！

57.title: 两种时态同台对比
57.chat: 这课把两种时态放在一起对比：every day（每天，习惯）用一般现在时；this morning / at the moment（此刻）用现在进行时。整点时间用 o'clock：eight o'clock 八点整。
57.formula: every day → 一般现在时 ｜ this morning / at the moment → be + 动词ing

examples.en: The children go to school by car every day.
This morning, they are going to school on foot.
examples.cn: 今天早上他们正步行去上学。

examples.en: At the moment, he's reading an interesting book.
examples.cn: 此刻，他正在读一本有趣的书。

57.watch: 乘交通工具用 by：by car / by bus；只有走路用 on：on foot 步行！

59.title: 购物：I want some…
59.chat: 买东西时说要什么：I want some envelopes, please.（请给我些信封）。店员问规格：the large size or the small size?（大的还是小的？）——or 连接的叫「选择疑问句」。买完说 That's all, thank you.
59.formula: I want some…, please. ｜ A or B? （选哪个？）

examples.en: I want some envelopes, please.
Do you want the large size or the small size?
examples.cn: 您要大号的还是小号的？

examples.en: Is that all?

59.watch: 选择疑问句不用 Yes/No 回答，直接选一个：The large size, please.！

61.title: 系动词：feel 和 look
61.chat: feel（感觉起来）和 look（看起来）是「系动词」，像小桥一样连接主语和形容词：He feels ill.（他觉得病了）He looks ill.（他看上去病了）。「感冒」是固定搭配 have a cold。
61.formula: 主语 + feel/look + 形容词 ｜ have a cold 感冒

examples.en: He feels ill. He looks ill.
examples.cn: 他觉得不舒服，看上去也病了。

examples.en: We must call the doctor.
He has a bad cold.

61.watch: 系动词后面跟形容词，不跟副词：look well ✓（well 这里是「健康的」这个形容词）

63.title: mustn't 不是「不必」！
63.chat: must 表示「必须」。它的否定 mustn't 不是「不必」，而是「禁止、千万不要」！真正的「不必」是 needn't。这对孪生兄弟是考试最爱，千万别认错！
63.formula: must = 必须 ｜ mustn't = 千万不要 ｜ needn't = 不必

examples.en: He mustn't get up yet.
He mustn't eat rich food.
He must stay in bed for another two days.

63.watch: Must I…? 的否定回答是 No, you needn't.（你不必），说 No, you mustn't. 就变成「禁止」啦！

65.title: 反身代词与 half past
65.chat: 自己「玩得开心」是 enjoy oneself—— oneself 就是反身代词：yourself（你自己）、ourselves（我们自己）。说「几点半」用 half past + 数字：half past ten 十点半。
65.formula: enjoy oneself = 玩得开心 ｜ half past + 数字 = ……点半

examples.en: Enjoy yourself!
We always enjoy ourselves.
You must be home at half past ten.

65.watch: 门钥匙说 the key to the door——用 to 表示「配套的」，不用 of！

67.title: be 动词的过去式：was / were
67.chat: 说「过去」的事，be 动词要换衣服：am/is → was，are → were。星期几前面用 on：on Monday（在星期一）。看到 last week（上周）、yesterday（昨天），就要想到过去式！
67.formula: I/he/she → was ｜ you/we/they → were ｜ on + 星期几

examples.en: Were you at the butcher's?
He was absent on Monday.
We're going to stay at my mother's for the weekend.
examples.cn: 我们要去我妈妈家过周末。

67.watch: my mother's 后面省略了 house：'s 也能代替「某人的家」哦！

69.title: there was / there were
69.chat: 过去「存在有」，There is/are 也要换过去式：There was（过去有一个）、There were（过去有一些）。hundred 前有具体数字不加 s：five hundred；不确指时才说 hundreds of（成百上千）。
69.formula: There was + 单数 ／ There were + 复数（过去有……）

examples.en: There was a very big race in 1995.
There were hundreds of people there.
There were twenty cars in the race.

69.watch: exciting 形容事物「令人激动」：an exciting finish 激动人心的结尾！

71.title: 动词过去式：加 ed
71.chat: 规则动词的过去式直接加 ed：telephoned、answered、typed。说「几次」用 times：一次 once、两次 twice、四次 four times。问过去的事用 did 开头，后面的动词变回原形！
71.formula: 动词 + ed = 过去式 ｜ once 一次 → twice 两次 → …times

examples.en: He telephoned me four times yesterday.
examples.cn: 他昨天给我打了4次电话。

examples.en: My boss answered the telephone.
Did he telephone again?

71.watch: did 后面的动词要「脱掉」ed 变回原形：Did he telephoned ❌ → Did he telephone ✓！

73.title: 不规则动词家族
73.chat: 英语有一批「不规则动词」，过去式要单独记，像记名字一样：go→went、lose→lost、see→saw、speak→spoke、take→took。问路句型 Can you tell me the way to…? 也超实用！

examples.en: Last week Mrs. Mills went to London.
examples.cn: 上周米尔斯夫人去了伦敦。

examples.en: She lost her way.
Can you tell me the way to King Street, please?

73.watch: 很多副词 = 形容词 + ly：slow→slowly（慢慢地）、sudden→suddenly（突然地）！

75.title: ago：过去的信号灯
75.chat: 「一段时间 + ago」是一般过去时的信号灯：a month ago（一个月前）→ 用过去式 bought。「在流行」是 in fashion，「过时了」是 out of fashion。
75.formula: 时间段 + ago → 一般过去时 ｜ in fashion 流行 ⇄ out of fashion 过时

examples.en: We had some shoes like those a month ago.
examples.cn: 一个月前我们有那种鞋。

examples.en: They were in fashion last year.
But they're not in fashion this year.

75.watch: buy 的过去式不规则：buy → bought！wear → wore（穿的过去式）也是。

77.title: 否定疑问句的语气
77.chat: Can't you…? 是否定疑问句，带着「你就不能……吗？」的语气（有点不耐烦或惊讶）。till = until，表示「直到……」。看病先问：Do you have an appointment?（您预约了吗？）
77.formula: Can't you + 动词…? （你就不能……吗？）｜ wait till… 等到……

examples.en: Do you have an appointment?
Is it urgent?
Can't you wait till this afternoon?
examples.cn: 您就不能等到今天下午吗？

77.watch: 牙疼是 have a toothache；看牙医是 see the dentist——两个固定搭配一起记！

79.title: have got 与 much/many
79.chat: have got 就是 have 的口语版：We haven't got much tea.（我们的茶不多了）。量词怎么选？much 配「数不清」的（much money），many 配「数得清」的（many eggs），a lot of 两者通吃！
79.formula: haven't got = don't have ｜ much + 不可数 ／ many + 可数 ／ a lot of 都可以

examples.en: We haven't got much tea or coffee.
examples.cn: 我们的茶和咖啡不多了。

examples.en: We need a lot of things this week.
examples.cn: 这里期我们需要很多东西。

examples.en: Have we got any beer and wine?
examples.cn: 我们还有啤酒和果酒吗？

79.watch: money 数不清：much money ✓ many money ❌！tomatoes 数得清：many tomatoes ✓

81.title: have 不只是「有」
81.chat: have + 名词 = 「做某件事」：have a bath 洗澡、have lunch 吃午饭、have a haircut 理发。因为是「做事」，它能用进行时：He's having a bath.（他正在洗澡）。have 的过去式是 had！
81.formula: have a bath / have lunch / have a haircut ｜ What did you have?（你们吃了什么？）

examples.en: He's upstairs. He's having a bath.
What did you have for lunch?
We had roast beef and potatoes.
examples.cn: 我们吃了烤牛肉和土豆。

81.watch: 问句里已经有 did，动词用原形：What did you had ❌ → What did you have ✓！

83.title: 现在完成时登场
83.chat: 现在完成时 = have/has + 过去分词，表示「已经做完，跟现在有关系」。already（已经）放在句中；yet（还）放在句尾，只出现在疑问句和否定句里。
83.formula: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词 ｜ Have you…yet? → I've already…

examples.en: Have you packed your suitcase yet?
I've already packed it.
I've just had a cup of coffee.

83.watch: pack→packed，have→had；go 的过去分词是 gone：be→was/were→been。

85.title: have been to 与 have gone to
85.chat: 「去过某地」（人已回来）用 have been to；「去了某地」（人还没回）用 have gone to。谈「人生的经历」用 ever（曾经）提问、never（从未）回答。
85.formula: have been to 去过（已回）｜ have gone to 去了（未回）｜ ever / never

examples.en: Have you just been to the cinema?
I've never been there.
Have you ever been there, Ken?

85.watch: been 是 be 的过去分词；seen 是 see 的过去分词（see→saw→seen）！

87.title: still 与 yet 的位置
87.chat: still（仍然）放在 be 动词后面：They're still working on it.（他们还在修呢）。yet（还）放在句尾，配合否定：not ready yet（还没好）。两个不规则过去式一起记：drive→drove、bring→brought。
87.formula: 主语 + be + still + 动词ing ｜ not… yet 还没……

examples.en: Isn't your car ready yet?
They're still working on it.
I drove it into a lamp-post.
examples.cn: 我把它撞到路灯杆上了。

87.watch: try to do = 设法做：They're trying to repair it. 他们正设法修。

89.title: for 和 since 的分工
89.chat: 现在完成时说「持续了多久」：for + 一段时间（for twenty years 二十年），since + 起点（since 1976 从1976年起）。问价钱用 How much…? 问时长用 How long…?
89.formula: have + 过去分词 + for + 时间段 ／ since + 时间点

examples.en: How long have you lived here?
I've lived here for twenty years.
I've been here since 1976.

89.watch: for 后面跟「20年」这样的长度，since 后面跟「1976年」这样的起点，一个管长度、一个管起点！

91.title: Has he…yet? 与 will
91.chat: 现在完成时的一般疑问句把 Have/Has 提前：Has he sold his house yet?（他卖掉房子了吗？）；yet 在这里表示“已经”，并不是每个疑问句都必须加 yet。will 表示将来：I’ll miss him.（我会想念他）。本课 He’s still here 中 still 放在 be 动词后。
91.formula: Has + 主语 + 过去分词 + yet? ｜ 主语 + will + 动词原形

examples.en: Has Ian sold his house yet?
He's going to move tomorrow.
We'll all miss him.

91.watch: miss 有两个意思：想念朋友／错过公交车（I missed the bus!）

93.title: will：将来的车票
93.chat: will + 动词原形 = 将来做某事：He will fly to New York. 缩写成 he'll。时间轴背下来：last week 上周 → next month 下个月 → the week after next 下下周。
93.formula: 主语 + will + 动词原形（将要……）

examples.en: He will fly to New York next month.
He'll return to London the week after next.
He has already been to nearly every country.
examples.cn: 他几乎已经去过每个国家。

93.watch: fly to… 就是「飞去……」，return to… 是「回到……」——to 后面跟地点！

95.title: had better：最好做……
95.chat: had better + 动词原形 = 「最好做……」，谁用都不变形：We had better go.（我们最好走）。问将来的时间点：What time will…?
95.formula: had better + 动词原形 = 最好…… ｜ What time will…?

examples.en: What time will the next train leave?
We had better go back to the station now.
examples.cn: 我们现在最好回车站去。

examples.en: We've got plenty of time.

95.watch: had better 缩写成 'd better：We'd better hurry!（我们最好快点！）
